What we do

Pest services for homes & businesses

From a single wasp nest to a full property protection plan, we handle the pests that trouble South Sound homes, offices and apartments.

Ant Control

We track ants to the colony and treat the source — kitchen trails, pavement ants and the odorous house ants common around the Sound.

Call about ants →

Hornet & Wasp Control

Yellow jackets, hornets and paper wasps removed safely — including aerial nests in trees, eaves and ground nests in the yard.

Call about wasps →

Rodent Control & Prevention

Rats and mice trapped and removed, then we seal the entry points and set up prevention so they don't come back.

Call about rodents →

Spider Control

We clear webs and treat the corners, crawl spaces and eaves where spiders settle — inside and out.

Call about spiders →

Cockroach Service

Targeted treatments for kitchens, bathrooms and multi-unit buildings, with follow-up until the infestation is gone.

Call about roaches →

Bed Bug Control

Careful inspection and treatment of bedrooms and furniture so you can sleep easy again — homes, rentals and apartments.

Call about bed bugs →
About us

A local family business, three generations strong

Sound Pest Solutions has been family owned since 2010, built on three generations and more than 45 years of pest control experience. We live and work in the same South Sound communities we serve — Steilacoom, DuPont, Anderson Island and across Pierce and Thurston Counties.

When you call, you talk to people who know the local pests, the local seasons, and what it takes to keep a Northwest home protected year-round.

How it works

Simple, honest pest control

No pressure and no surprises — just a clear process from first call to a pest-free home.

1

Call & describe it

Tell us what you're seeing. We'll ask a few questions and schedule a visit that fits your day.

2

Inspect & identify

We inspect inside and out, identify the pest and find how it's getting in.

3

Treat the problem

Targeted treatment for the pest at hand — only what's needed, where it's needed.

4

Keep them out

Prevention steps and follow-up service so the problem stays solved.
